 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u077/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d024dbe3.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Recover the hidden 4x4 patch from its 180-degree symmetric counterpart."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    if not cells:
        raise ValueError("No 3-colored mask found")
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    return [[grid[h - 1 - r][w - 1 - c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
}
